{{Quote|The Kyber crystal, the data on which can only be read by holocrons.''"<br />"''What's on the crystal?''"<br />"''A list of every known Force-sensitive child in the galaxy, the future younglings, the future of the Jedi Order.|Mace Windu and Ahsoka Tano|audio=KyberCrystal-HH.flac|<ref name="HH">{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}</ref>}}
The '''Kyber memory crystal''', or simply the '''Kyber crystal''', was a [[Memory crystal/Legends|memory crystal]] that contained a list of all known [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. As it was considered to hold the future of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], it was highly valuable to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The information contained in the crystal could only be accessed when placed in a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] which, in turn, could only be opened with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. It was vital for the operation of the [[Acquisition Division/Legends|Acquisition Division]] of the Order, for they actively sought potential students of the Force. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the crystal was kept and protected by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]]. While Ropal was on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]], [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] kidnapped him and stole the memory crystal. Later, during a mission to recover a holocron Bane had stolen from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was coerced into opening the holocron to save his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan's]] life. Bane then inserted the Kyber crystal into the holocron, making it possible for his client to access the information stored within. The crystal was believed destroyed, along with Bane, when the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigate]] they were on exploded. Bane survived, however, taking the crystal and holocron with him when he escaped the doomed frigate.

==Characteristics==
[[File:KyberCrystal-CoD.png|thumb|left|220px|The Kyber crystal within a holocron]]
The Kyber [[Memory crystal/Legends|memory crystal]] was a small, [[Color/Legends|blue]], [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]]-shaped [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] which held the identities of every known [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TCW:VGUB" /> This information was critical to the future of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], as without it, the next generation of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] could not be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]], and was therefore extremely valuable. The crystal was designed in such a way that its data could only be accessed if it were to be installed in a Jedi [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]. In turn, the holocron could only be opened by a Jedi's use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The two components were kept separate; the holocron was stored within the [[Holocron Chamber]] of the well-protected [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], while the crystal itself remained in the care of a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] named [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]].<ref name="HH" />

==History==
{{Quote|Now we'll combine this holocron with the memory crystal I acquired from your dead Jedi friend.|Cad Bane|audio=HolocronMemoryCrystal-CoD.flac|<ref name="CoD" />}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="swannual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] hired the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to infiltrate the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and steal a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] necessary to accessing the information stored on the Kyber crystal.<ref name="HH" /> After executing [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|operation]] and escaping the temple, Bane was given command of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] task force to [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|attack]] a [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Republic outpost]] on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]],<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> where he kidnapped Jedi Master Bolla Ropal, the keeper and guardian of the crystal.<ref name="CoD" />

While departing Devaron, Bane's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was intercepted by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. The bounty hunter's task force was systematically eliminated by the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] until only Bane's [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] remained. When Bane's [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigate]] attempted to escape, the Jedi ship shot the bounty hunter's hyper drive. Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], then led a team of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and boarded Bane's [[Frigate/Legends|vessel]] with the intent of rescuing Master Ropal and recovering the stolen holocron and memory crystal. Once on board, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were lured into a trap by the Duros hunter. Skywalker was forced to open the holocron and let Bane insert the crystal in order to save his Padawan's life. Bane then took the completed holocron, opened an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] to blow the two Jedi into space, and escaped. The Jedi were able to close the airlock in time and escape the doomed ship.

[[File:Memory_crystal.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Cad Bane apprehends the Kyber crystal.]]
Bane and the memory crystal were believed to be destroyed when the frigate exploded; however, he escaped the destruction of his ship disguised in [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]] aboard the same [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class shuttle]] Skywalker and his team had commandeered. When Bane escaped with the crystal he captured two out of the three children he was sent to get before falling for a trap planned by Skywalker and Tano. Only after Masters [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and Jedi Skywalker [[Mind trick/Legends|coerced]] Bane with the Force did the Duros take them to his hideout. Once on his space station, Windu and Kenobi were able to recover the holocron; though Bane fled after activating the security measures installed in his sanctuary. It was said that the Bane never copied the list before it was recovered by the Order.<ref name="CoD" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This holocron carries information I've been paid to collect.|Cad Bane's incorrect statement|<ref name="CoD" />}}
The Kyber memory crystal was first mentioned in early drafts of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] as the "Kiber crystal." It was a [[Force artifact/Legends|Force artifact]] sought by both the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="AotS">''[[Adventures of the Starkiller, Episode I: The Star Wars]]''</ref><ref name="FAoLTS">''[[The Star Wars: From The Adventures of Luke Starkiller]]''</ref> The plot line was ultimately removed from the story in later drafts of the script. The crystal was revived as the [[Kaiburr crystal]] in the [[1978]] novel ''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''. During early development of the script for [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']], the term "Kyber" was considered for use once again. The poison dart [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] used to assassinate [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] was originally going to be identified as a [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] kyber dart. This was again changed in the finished film to be a [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|saberdart]].<ref name="Saberdart-Databank">{{DB|technology|kaminosaberdart|Kamino saberdart}}</ref> The term "[[Kyber dart]]" was reused in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''.<ref name="KOTORII">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> Despite this, {{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode202.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cargo of Doom}} said, "Finally, after over 30 years, the term "Kyber" with its original spelling has worked its way into a [[canon]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' story."<ref name="CoD EpGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode202.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cargo of Doom}}</ref>

During "Cargo of Doom," Cad Bane states that the holocron contains information he's been paid to collect. This is inaccurate, as the Kyber crystal contains the actual information and the holocron is only the means of accessing the data. It is unclear if this was an oversight by the script writers or an intentional element.

Despite the name previously in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]] referring to the memory crystal, the term "kyber crystal" would later be used to describe [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] in the ''The Clone Wars'' episode, "[[A Test of Strength]]".<ref name="TCWTestOfStrength">{{TCW|A Test of Strength}}</ref>
